name: drupal/varbase_ai_content_operations_base
description: A content operations assistant for the editors of a Varbase 11 site: audits broken internal links and missing alt text, drafts missing meta descriptions, finds unused and near-duplicate terms, reports editorial status, and renames a term across content with a diff. It works with the editor's own permissions, shows every change first, and saves only what the editor approves, as new revisions. Experimental: Tool API and Tool Belt have no stable release. No custom PHP or shell code.
